name: Boyne Country RV Park & Campground
note: Small RV park on M-75 a mile from Boyne Mountain (1890 S M-75, Boyne City), on the paved trail toward Boyne Falls and Boyne City. Basic rates $44-69 a night by site and party; motorhomes limited to 30 ft without calling ahead. Online booking (Campspot) or quote by phone; seasonal sites too. --Claude

name: Rifle River RV Resort & Campground
note: RV resort on a bend of the Rifle River at the Melita Road bridge (334 Melita Rd, Sterling), May 1-Oct 12. Full-hookup and water/electric sites, 20/30/50 amp, riverfront sites, dump station, canoe and tube rentals. RV sites from $30 a night ($40 weekend nights). Run by the Outdoor Adventures family but books nightly to the public online (CampLife). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: rifleriverresort.com rates page read 2026-10-03: spacious RV sites daily from $30, weekend from $40, weekly $215; public online booking via CampLife; season May 1-Oct 12. Phone is Outdoor Adventures' reservations line, but unlike its membership resorts (Kalamazoo skipped) this one sells nightly to anyone, the Encore precedent. RV Life unrated -> published rate <= $50 passes; Google 4.1 over 495

name: CreationView Campground
note: Wooded Irish Hills campground off US-12 (16230 US-12, Cement City), the former Irish Hills Campground reopened under new owners: gravel pads, full hookups, wide roads for any rig, pool. 2026 rates: back-in $50, pull-through $55 a night. Online booking (CampLife). --Claude
